title: Reset password
subtitle: We will send a verification code so you can set a new password.
note: Use the email address connected to your SoccerOctopus account.
verificationCopy: Enter the verification code sent to {email} and choose a new password.

errors.fallback: Unable to reset your password. Please try again.
errors.requirements: New password does not meet the password requirements.
errors.secondFactor: Password reset succeeded, but this account requires an additional verification step. Please sign in to continue.
errors.complete: Unable to complete password reset. Please request a new code and try again.
